title: I Left the Motel Review With the Exact Smoke-Alarm Beep Time

parts.text: I filmed the smoke alarm at 2:13 a.m., 2:41, and 3:08 because it chirped on a dying battery the desk had promised to fix at check-in. I was forty-nine, driving through on a work trip, holding a pillow over one ear. Morning I showed the desk the timestamps. They offered a late checkout. I took it and still wrote the review with 2:13, 2:41, and 3:08 in the first line, plus the promise from check-in. They replied that batteries are random. Random is a schedule. The next guest can read a clock. I slept from 6 to 10 in protest, legally. The chirp is in writing. Work still happened. The pillow went back in the car smelling like a 9-volt. I do not exaggerate in reviews. I timestamp.

social.description: Promised fix, late checkout, first line of the review was a clock. Would you have named the minutes?
